title: New microscopes in the CBI
body: This is going to be a very exciting month in the CBI which multiple new systems coming on line. The first is a spinning disk confocal with live cell capabilities, Ideal for organoid imaging as well as timelapse live cell. It can be used for plate or dish based assays. Its an exciting new device generously provided to the CBI by the Hillman Cancer Center. Please contact Callen and Mike for training and access

title: CBI EM lab using PITT iLABS for Billing
body: The CBI EM lab will now be using iLABS for billing. (see link for signing up). Please reach out to the EM staff for help with the changes and if you are a new client of our EM services, please reach out to the Faculty before requesting EM services.

title: the new NIE-II slide scanner
body: We have a really really cool new slide scanner for both bright field and fluorescence. 8 slides, fully automatic... Amazing fluorescence scans with no pincushioning or stitching artefacts. Ask Katherine for training. It is very impressive

title: EM usage policy changes for the CBI
body: Our EM usage policy has changed significantly. Have a look at the usage policy page to see what is different

title: Gotta love another paper in Nature.. well done Rod and team
Tremendous news.. the CBI was awarded another NIH S10 grant for a new confocal microscope today
body: Keep your eyes peeled and be ready to integrate a brand new very high end confocal system into your work. It will be installed in the Satellite facility this summer. Once its in place we will let you know so you can reach out to Katherine for training
